translations.1: In the early morning, the mist outside the mountain gate has not yet dispersed.
translations.10: Senior Sister Zeng, Elder Qin asked you to go to the ward area. I and Senior Brother Wanqi are here.
translations.11: Okay. Miss Qiu has woken up, come call me immediately.
translations.12: Wàn Qìjì scratched his head, then turned and ran towards the foot of the mountain.
translations.13: Xiè Xuán stood at the palace entrance, her sword unsheathed, but the lights flickered for a moment.
translations.14: Elder Qin, how have you been? I come under the阁主's order to take three-tenths of the qi stones.
translations.15: Three parts? The qi stones are painstakingly saved by the sect, when is it outsiders' turn to take them?
translations.16: The ward is already cracked, it's not safe to keep the qi stones in your hands. I will come again in three days.
translations.17: Xiè Xuán sneered, turned and left without looking back.
translations.18: Saying three days is three days, I never break my word.
translations.19: Elder Qin stroked his beard and looked at Chou Shuang, who was sleeping on the couch.
translations.2: Yunzhou, you're finally back. Did you bring enough qi stones?
translations.20: Elder, let me guard the ward. Miss Qiu has Yuè Chuān to look after her, so I can leave.
translations.21: Finally, he nodded and took a jade talisman from his sleeve.
translations.22: This is the formation eye token. Only by guarding it can you be said to have guarded your path.
translations.23: Yuè Chuān tucked the medicine pouch into Yúnzhōu's怀里, and whispered a few more instructions.
translations.24: At the mountain gate, Wanqi Jing handed over a straw raincoat.
translations.25: Thank you, Senior Brother Wanqi. Miss Qiu has woken up, and she sends her thanks to me.
translations.26: Shàn Yúnzhōu nodded, tucking the formation eye token close to his body.
translations.27: In the hall, Qiu Shuang slowly opened her eyes.
translations.28: It's good that you're awake. You were unconscious all day, don't move around ▼
translations.29: Chou Shuang struggled to sit up, looking at the cracked sky outside the window.
translations.3: I brought three bags, all from the best in the back mountain.
translations.30: Unnoticed, the letter in her sleeve bore Xie Xuan's seal.
translations.4: The ward cracked again last night; Elder Qin hasn't slept all night.
translations.5: Before his words fell, Wanqi Jing rushed up from the foot of the mountain.
translations.6: He panted and said, a young woman was lying on the roadside at the foot of the mountain
translations.7: Quick, lift her up. Ruoshui, go get the healing pills.
